sections.title: Section 1: Paragliding School Inquiry
sections.html:
insurance

(noun). bảo hiểm

Having health insurance can really help you if you suddenly become sick and cannot work anymore.

injury

(noun). thương tích, vết thương

He had an injury on his leg from the car accident.

property

(noun). tài sản

Your house and land are also your property.

belongings

(noun). đồ dùng cá nhân

Remember to put all your personal belongings in your backpack so you don't lose anything.

theft

(noun). việc mất trộm

There was a case of car theft on our street last week.

keen

(adjective). hăng hái, nhiệt tình

Though he is young, he's a very keen reader.

cyclist

(noun). người đạp xe, vận động viên xe đạp

There are a lot of cyclists in the park today.

off the beaten track/path

(adjective). nơi xa xôi hẻo lánh

We traveled to a beautiful mountainous area that is off the beaten track because we didn't like crowded places.

in advance

(adverb). trước

Planning your meals out in advance can help you to develop healthier eating habits.

credit card

(noun). thẻ tín dụng

I mostly buy things online using my credit card.

pullover

(noun). áo len

What do you think about this pullover?

sleeve

(noun). tay áo

He rolls up his sleeves so they don't get wet while he's washing his hands.

fancy

(verb). muốn làm gì đó

My grandmother fancies having a cup of tea every morning.

recommend

(verb). gợi ý, đề xuất

I talked to my friends and they recommended me a few things that I should do.

lotion

(noun). kem dưỡng da, kem bôi ngoài da

It's usually best to apply moisturizing lotion after taking a shower.

accommodation

(noun). nơi ở

There are many hotels in this city, which means a lot of accommodation for tourists.

caravan

(noun). nhà lưu động

They travelled across the country in a caravan.

bed and breakfast

(noun). nhà trọ có bao gồm điểm tâm sáng

How about we stay at a bed and breakfast instead? That way we won't have to find a place to eat in the morning.

operate

(verb). tổ chức, quản lý

There are many things to consider when operating your own store.

field trip

(noun). chuyến tham quan thực tế

Our class went on a field trip to a national park so we could learn more about biology.

hostel

(noun). nhà trọ, nhà nghỉ

Let's just find a hostel for tonight since we only need a bed to sleep on.

pray

(verb). cầu nguyện

She prays that things will get better soon.

ring

(verb). gọi điện thoại

I'm busy right now, but I'll ring you later when I'm home.

sections.title: Section 2: Goodwood Car Show
sections.html:
luxurious

(adjective). sang trọng

They stayed in a luxurious hotel during their vacation.

model

(noun). mẫu

The car salesman showed me the newest model.

rare

(adjective). hiếm

A total solar eclipse is a rare natural event that only happens every few years.

two-seater

(noun). phương tiện có hai chỗ ngồi

This car is only a two-seater, so you can't fit your family in it.

engine

(noun). động cơ

The new engine technology allows the car to reach its top speed in just a few seconds.

absorb

(verb). hấp thụ, hút vào

If you wear a black shirt out in the sun, you're going to feel so much hotter because the color back absorbs the most light and heat.

vibration

(noun). sự rung động

This machine causes a lot of vibrations.

smooth

(adjective). êm ái, mượt

I really like this fabric because of how smooth it feels.

frame

(noun). bộ khung

We've just bought a new wooden window frame.

typical

(adjective). bình thường, điển hình

It was just another typical day like any other day for her.

attraction

(noun). điểm nhấn, điểm thu hút

The Effiel Tower is definitely the most popular tourist attraction in Paris.

instrument panel

(noun). bảng điều khiển

The instrument panel of the car shows you important information such as how fast you are going and how much gas the car has left.

feature

(noun). chi tiết, tác dụng

My old phone doesn't have many features except for calling and messaging.

stop-watch

(noun). đồng hồ bấm giờ

He's using a stop-watch to measure the time it takes for his friend to run around the yard.

capable

(adjective). có khả năng

He's capable of doing many things at one time.

aviation

(noun). ngành hàng không

A few of my friends work in the aviation business.

pioneer

(noun). người tiên phong

Do you know who was the pioneer in the field of photography and camera?

apparent

(adjective). rõ ràng

It's apparent that the bananas on the left aren't good enough to eat yet.

resemble

(verb). nhìn giống, có sự tương đồng với cái gì đó

He really resembles his father in a lot of ways.

wing

(noun). cánh

The bird open its two wings

steer >> steering (n)

(verb). lái, điều khiển

In order to steer the car, just use the steering wheel.

bizarre

(adjective). kỳ lạ, kỳ quặc

Several traditional dishes in Asia could be seen as bizarre by Western people.

rear

(adjective). ở phía sau

I think there's a flat tire on one of my rear wheels.

hefty

(adjective). to lớn

His dream house came with a hefty price tag.

dominate

(verb). thống trị

He dominated the competition and won the first prize.

frail

(adjective). yếu, mỏng manh

My grandma is almost 90 years old, so she's really frail.

sections.title: Section 3: Survey On Local Entertainment
sections.html:
survey

(noun). khảo sát, bản điều tra

A survey shouldn't be too long, or else people won't want to complete it.

entertainment

(noun). việc giải trí

Many people have different kinds of entertainment at home.

facilities

(noun). các phương tiện, công cụ, trang thiết bị

Some housing facilities were damaged by the storm.

campus

(noun). khuôn viên trường

This is the campus of James Cook University.

deliberately

(adverb). một cách cố ý

The boy deliberately broke his sister's doll just to make her cry.

omit

(verb). bỏ qua, bỏ đi

I think you should omit this part from your paper, as it doesn't go well with the rest of your essay.

examine

(verb). xem xét

Let me examine this letter for a minute.

seat

(noun). chỗ ngồi, ghế ngồi

When she rides the bus, she always chooses the window seat.

tend to

(verb). thường

He tends to wake up at 7 every morning.

detract

(verb). làm giảm đi

Don't let the success of other people detract from your own success.

realize

(verb). nhận ra

It took a while but they finally realized that he had a good idea for the next company product.

vary >> variety (n)

(verb). thay đổi, làm cho khác nhau

It's a good idea to vary what you eat every day so you won't get bored of it.

budget

(noun). ngân sách

We have a big budget to spend on this project.

trail off

(verb). giảm dần dần, biến mất dần dần

They started off strong, but then began to trail off over time until they went out of business.

specialize

(verb). chuyên về gì đó

This place specializes in bridal makeup for Indian women.

minimal

(adjective). tối thiểu, tối giản

I like the minimal design of this bedroom.

lively

(adjective). sống động

It's part of teacher's job to make the class lively and not boring for students.

venue

(noun). địa điểm

We have just agreed on the venue for the wedding.

basement

(noun). tầng hầm

The building includes a basement

reasonable

(adjective). hợp lý, có lý

The price of that coat isn't reasonable at all.

deserve

(verb). xứng đáng

He made so many bad decisions that everyone believed he deserved to lose his job.

top marks

(noun). điểm cao nhất

I'm so happy that I received top marks for my homework.

category

(noun). thể loại

There are six main categories of animals.

musical

(noun). nhạc kịch

My friends and I went to the theater to see the new musical last weekend.

rating

(noun). đánh giá

If you enjoy your service, please give us a 5-star rating.

sections.title: Section 4: The Adverse Effects Of Desert Dust On Global Climate
sections.html:
impact

(noun). tác động

COVID-19 has had huge impacts on all over the world.

dust

(noun). bụi

We haven't cleaned the fan for a few months, so a lot of dust has built up inside it.

desert

(noun). sa mạc

Many deserts are covered in sand.

extent

(noun). mức độ

So, to what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?

implication

(noun). sự liên can, mối quan hệ mật thiết

According to the Domino Effect, one action or thing can have a far-reaching implication on something else.

remove

(verb). bỏ đi, bỏ ra chỗ khác

She removes her makeup before going to bed.

erosion

(noun). sự xói mòn, sự ăn mòn

Heavy rain has caused major soil erosion in the area.

vegetation

(noun). thực vật

The forest floor is covered with dense vegetation.

drainage

(noun). hệ thống thoát nước

I think we should invest in a better drainage system for our farm.

mismanagement

(noun). sự quản lý sai cách, quản lý kém

His mismanagement of the company has caused great damage to its business.

commonplace

(adjective). thường thấy, dễ thấy

ATMs are so commonplace nowadays that you can find many machines next to each other at any supermarket.

generate

(verb). tạo ra

Turbines can generate clean energy from winds.

thunderstorm

(noun). bão sấm sét

There were thunderstorms last night

hazard >> hazardous (adj)

(noun). mối nguy hiểm

Forest fires are a serious hazard to people who live near the affected areas.

deposit

(verb). đọng lại

Chemicals have been found to be deposited into the sea, killing coral reefs and other animals.

machine operator

(noun). người vận hành máy

He is training her to become a machine operator.

originate

(verb). bắt nguồn từ

It is generally believed that humans originated from apes.

prolonged

(adjective). kéo dài, lâu dài

Prolonged sitting can lead to serious back problems.

human-induced

(adjective). do con người tạo ra

Scientists believe that climate change and global warming are human-induced.

demise

(noun). cái chết, sự tiêu diệt

Addiction to smoking can lead to an early demise.

intensive

(adjective). mạnh mẽ, dồn dập, cấp tốc

Participants will take part in an intensive training course that will last for two weeks.

irrigation

(noun). hệ thống tưới nước cho cây

Nowadays, most irrigation systems are automatic.

volume

(noun). thể tích, tổng lượng nước

I have several jars of different volumes.

halve

(verb). giảm một nửa, chia đôi

The value of the Bitcoin has now halved.

salinity >> saline (adj)

(noun). độ mặn

The level of salinity in the Dead Sea is so high that you can easily float on its water.

adversely

(adverb). một cách có hại, một cách bất lợi

If a pregnant woman smokes, their unborn baby may be adversely affected.

toxic

(adjective). độc hại

Cigarette smoke can be very toxic and cause many health problems.

soil

(noun). đất trồng cây

I've just bought some fresh soil for my garden.

rainfall

(noun). lượng mưa

There's been heavy rainfall every week this month so far.

consequence

(noun). hậu quả

If you do something bad, you will get the consequence later.
